title: Fleet Roster Enrollment and the Covered-Mileage Percentage — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Fleet roster enrollment and the treadwear adjustment credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** For the treadwear adjustment credit the customer care desk works out on a personal-use vehicle, commercial use is read from the vehicle's enrollment on a Crestline Fleet Account roster during the set's active life, and it takes points off the covered-mileage percentage.

**Enrollment months.** The roster part of commercial use is counted in whole calendar months of enrollment on a Crestline Fleet Account roster, from the later of the enrollment date and the set's install date to the removal date, or to today while the vehicle is still enrolled. A vehicle removed from the roster before the set's install date was not enrolled during the set's active life. The set's active-life months are the whole calendar months from the install date to today.

**Commercial-use cut.**
| Enrollment during the set's active life | Points taken off the covered-mileage percentage | Warranty term |
|---|---|---|
| at least 1 whole month and at least half of the active-life months | 100 less the line's commercial-use share | the line's commercial-use term |
| at least 1 whole month but less than half of the active-life months | 100 less the midpoint of 100 and the line's commercial-use share, the midpoint rounded down to a whole percent | the line's ordinary warranty term |
| less than 1 whole month, or never | nothing | the line's ordinary warranty term |

This commercial-use cut takes the place of the commercial-use reading of the effective warranted miles for this credit.

| Line | Commercial-use share | Enrolled at least half | Enrolled less than half |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 100 points; term 0 months | 50 points (midpoint 50); term 48 months |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 0% | 100 points; term 0 months | 50 points (midpoint 50); term 60 months |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 30% | 70 points; term 36 months | 35 points (midpoint 65); term 60 months |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 50% | 50 points; term 48 months | 25 points (midpoint 75); term 60 months |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 40% | 60 points; term 36 months | 30 points (midpoint 70); term 72 months |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 40% | 60 points; term 36 months | 30 points (midpoint 70); term 72 months |

**Both sides of half (hypothetical vehicle, 20 active-life months):** 10 months enrolled is at least half — full cut; 9 months is less than half — midpoint cut; enrollment of under one whole month takes nothing off.
